test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Mr. Suman opened the door.

options.text: The door is being opened by Mr. Suman
The door is opened by Mr. Suman.
The door was being opened by Mr. Suman.
The door was opened by Mr. Suman.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Mr. Suman opened the door."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the door" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "opened" to "was opened" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Mr. Suman."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The door was opened by Mr. Suman."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The door is being opened by Mr. Suman." – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"The door is opened by Mr. Suman." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The door was being opened by Mr. Suman." – Incorrect tense (past continuous passive).
